title: Example: laminar channel (synthetic template)
description: Minimal tutorial case: mesh + laminar solver + initialization + save. It shows the profile format (parameters, computations, presets, journal template); it does NOT reproduce a specific scientific run. Add your own BCs and reports.

verification.evidence: Synthetic example. The journal is assembled only from verified recipes (read-case, mesh/check, laminar, solver, p-v-coupling, number-of-iterations, reporting-interval, hyb-initialization, residual criteria, write-case-data), but it does not reproduce someone else's run and contains no third-party data.
verification.notes: This is a template for learning the profile format. For a real problem use fluent_case_interview → fluent_case_plan({spec}) or add your own profile under data/profiles/ or config.profileDirs.
